title: Show HN: 18 Words
summary: 18 Words is a minimalist web-based writing game or tool where users are challenged to create content using exactly 18 words, encouraging creative constraint-based writing in a clean, distraction-free interface.
problem_solved: Provides a creative writing constraint tool that helps overcome writer's block through focused 18-word challenges
why_valuable: Its simplicity and high engagement (1000+ points on HN) demonstrate the appeal of constraint-based creativity tools that make writing fun and accessible
